needsReview.why: The payout is any output with the right address and amount, found by searching all outputs without tying it to this script input. One payment satisfies every script input spent in the same transaction.
needsReview.attackSketch: Spend two script UTxOs owed to the same address in one transaction and pay the price once; each validator finds the same output.

groundTruthBugs: deposit into another account can take control of its funds

needsReview.why: A redeemer branch of a spend handler returns True with no check on the outputs, so the continuing datum (for example its owner field) is unconstrained by this script.
needsReview.attackSketch: Spend through the unconstrained branch and write a continuing output whose datum names an attacker-controlled owner, then use the owner-gated branch to withdraw.
